trial_court: Family Court, Balotra in Civil Original (Family Dispute) Case No.67/2021
case_name: Bhagwat Singh @ Bhagwan Singh vs Khushboo Kanwar @ Manju Kanwar

parties.respondent_defendant: Khushboo Kanwar @ Manju Kanwar, Devyani Solanki (wife and second wife)

facts_of_case: Appellant-husband filed an application under Section 19 of the Family Courts Act, 1984 to assailing the order dated 31.05.2022 passed by the learned Family Court, Balotra. Respondent-wife filed an application under Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking declaration of the second marriage solemnized between the appellant and respondent No.2 as void on the ground of lack of jurisdiction.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to annul a marriage to prove that the marriage is null and void.
legal_principles.held: It is held that the respondent has not discharged the burden of proving that the marriage is null and void.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage registration certificate issued by a competent authority is prima facie evidence of the validity of the marriage.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a marriage registration certificate issued by a competent authority is prima facie evidence of the validity of the marriage.

outcome.final_order: The order dated 31.05.2022 passed by the learned Family Court, Balotra is set aside.
